subject: Heliotrope payment pilot: proposed alternate remit structure and approval
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah@heliotrope.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Billing cadence & credit terms for renewal

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the helpful rollout call yesterday. Procurement reviewed the renewed SOW and we have two asks to get internal approval across finance and legal: 1) move to a Net-90 payment term for the subscription portion (their standard for vendor contracts), and 2) invoice via a quarterly split rather than a single annual invoice so their treasury can match disbursements to project milestones.

We understand this is non-standard — our finance director is comfortable with this as a pilot for the first 12 months if Redwood can accommodate. We attached the updated SOW and a suggested payment schedule (Heliotrope_PaymentPlan.xlsx).

Can you let me know what exceptions Redwood would need (e.g., prepay, retention, escrow, billing hold language)? We’re on a tight cycle and would like to execute before Mar 1 to align with our FY.

Thanks,
Sarah Lee
Head of Finance, Heliotrope AI

Attachment: Heliotrope_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Heliotrope_PaymentPlan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah@heliotrope.ai>, contracts@heliotrope.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Billing cadence & credit terms for renewal

Folks — forwarding Heliotrope’s ask. TL;DR: Requesting Net-90 + quarterly invoicing (their treasury preference) as a one-year pilot. Deal is $720k ARR (renewal), includes $120k one-time professional services in Q1. They need sign-off before Mar 1.

My recommendation: consider a conditional approval with these guardrails:
- Require the $120k PS to be invoiced 50% upfront (to reduce delivery credit exposure)
- Accept Net-90 on subscription invoices for the first 12 months only, after which revert to standard Net-30
- Add billing-hold and collection carve-outs in the SOW (payment hold triggers for fraud or breach only)
- Ask for a PO and ACH mandate; if ACH not possible, require a signed escrow agreement or a letter of credit

Attached: payment plan I drafted showing one upfront invoice + two quarterly subscription invoices.

I’m comfortable escalating if finance/legal need additional mitigations. Heliotrope is strategic — fast-moving client in ML ops, expansion potential.

Thanks — Monica
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Helio_payment_plan_proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Billing cadence & credit terms for renewal

On Thu, Feb 18, 2027 at 11:03 AM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com> wrote:
> Folks — forwarding Heliotrope’s ask. TL;DR: Requesting Net-90 + quarterly invoicing (their treasury preference) as a one-year pilot. Deal is $720k ARR (renewal), includes $120k one-time professional services in Q1.

I ran a quick credit check and risk is moderate — their burn has normalized but receivables aging with some peers is stretched out. I have two concerns: 1) exposure if subscription renewals are delayed beyond Net-90 for future terms, and 2) cashflow impact if multiple customers push extended terms in the same quarter.

Compromise options I’d support without elevated credit controls:
- Option A (preferred): Net-60 subscription invoices, quarterly invoicing; require ACH mandate and a PO.
- Option B (pilot): Net-90 subscription for 12 months only, but with 50% of the PS invoiced and collected upfront and a contractual guarantee of a PO + ACH setup within 30 days of signature. If ACH not provided, add a 1% processing surcharge and require enterprise billing contact to sign an extended payment addendum.

If Sales wants Net-90 unconditional, we’ll need CFO approval and a security deposit / letter of credit equal to one quarter of subscription revenue.

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Heliotrope_CreditMemo.pdf (pdf)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah@heliotrope.ai>, contracts@heliotrope.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 09:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Billing cadence & credit terms for renewal

Thanks for the context. I’m approving a limited pilot to preserve the relationship and close the renewal before their FY deadline, subject to the following conditions:

1) Acceptance: Net-90 on subscription invoices for the first 12 months only (pilot).
2) Invoicing cadence: Split subscription into three quarterly invoices (equal amounts) across the year.
3) Upfront PS: 50% of the $120k PS is invoiced and must be collected within Net-30 of signature. Work can begin after the initial invoice is paid.
4) Risk mitigations: Heliotrope must provide a PO and ACH mandate within 30 days of signature. If ACH is not established by day 30, Redwood may apply a 1.5% extended-terms fee on outstanding balances and reserve the right to pause non-critical deployments until payment is remediated.
5) Legal: add explicit billing hold carve-outs in SOW; procurement disputes will not automatically suspend payments unrelated to the dispute.

This approval is time-limited for this renewal only and contingent on Finance (Marcus) confirming PO/ACH and Legal clearing the SOW language. Monica — please confirm you’ll get a signed PO and DocuSign executed SOW by Feb 26. If not, escalate to me for next steps.

- Aditya
VP, Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@heliotrope.ai>, contracts@heliotrope.ai
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing cadence & credit terms for renewal — approval and next steps

Hi Sarah / Heliotrope team —

Thanks for your patience. Good news: Redwood can run a one-year pilot with the alternate remit structure. Summary of approved terms (please confirm):
- Pilot term: 12 months starting on effective date of SOW
- Subscription payment: Net-90 for subscription invoices for the pilot year; invoices issued quarterly (3 equal subscription invoices across the 12 months)
- Professional services: $120,000 total; 50% ($60,000) due upfront (invoice at signature), remainder invoiced upon delivery milestones
- Operational requirements: Heliotrope to provide PO and ACH mandate within 30 days of signature. If ACH is not provided by day 30, Redwood may apply a 1.5% extended-terms fee and reserve the right to pause non-critical deployments after notice.
- Legal language: We will add billing-hold carve-outs and a limited dispute process in the SOW; procurement disputes do not automatically suspend payment obligations.

Attached is the SOW prepared for signature and a DocuSign link to execute: https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123-heliotrope-sow. Please confirm acceptance by Feb 26 so we can lock pricing for the renewal.

If you want, I can set up a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through the payment schedule and PO details.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
